name: SLS Medical Supply
old_description: SLS Medical Supply delivers essential medical supplies to the healthcare industry, ensuring quality and reliability for medical professionals.
about:
SLS Medical Supply operates from Lakewood, New Jersey, where it provides medical supplies and personal protective equipment to healthcare facilities across the United States. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The firm functions as a distributor, sourcing branded medical products and managing corporate accounts for institutional buyers. It reports serving more than 600 facilities, 80,000 patients, 40,000 providers, and processing over 50,000 transactions. Services include 24/7 emergency support and a focus on cost-effective procurement.

Its customer base spans skilled nursing facilities, assisted living communities, emergency care centers, physician offices, clinics, dental practices, pediatrics, geriatrics, and hospitals. The company emphasizes reliable delivery and competitive pricing for high-volume institutional orders.

SLS Medical Supply positions itself on reliability, competitive pricing, and a customer service model built on honesty and integrity. It highlights 24/7 emergency availability and deep industry experience as key differentiators for healthcare providers seeking consistent supply chain performance.
